entities.name: Language Revival Movements
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Organized efforts to revitalize endangered or dormant languages as expressions of cultural identity and political sovereignty. From the revival of Hebrew as a spoken language in Palestine to Irish Gaelic revival, Catalan normalization, and contemporary efforts to preserve indigenous languages, these movements assert that linguistic diversity is essential to cultural survival.
